capabilities: generate a title for the active note from its content
generate titles for multiple selected files at once
trigger generation from command palette, editor menu, or file context menu
set titles directly on the notes
lower-case all generated titles via a setting
extras: Generating a title overwrites the note's existing title; README suggests running multiple times for variations.
problem: Naming untitled notes is tedious, especially across many files, and Obsidian has no built-in automatic titling.
summary: AI title generator that creates note titles from note content using OpenAI's GPT-3.5, for one note or many at once.
